data.name: Carneros Sip 'N Cycle
data.headline: From $250 • 5 Hours • Bike in the Burgundy of California  • All ages!
data.description:
#Bike in the Burgundy of California! 

##Rates
 • **Adult** $250 *Ages 17 and up*
 • **Child/Teen** $126.75 *Ages <15*

##Time
 **10:00AM - 3:30PM**

##About
Wide open spaces, lots of fantastic Pinot Noir, Chardonnays and other great wines. Quiet roads Fun, smaller family owned wineries. Close to Napa but far from the all the crowds. Only 10 minutes from Napa and usually cooler than the rest of the Napa Valley, the Carneros is becoming a guest favorite. There are quiet roads to bike along, great wineries that are some of our guide’s favorites. You can see for miles here and being so close to San Pablo Bay you can get whiff of the sea air. Rolling hills and never ending vineyards. Come bike with us in the Carneros!

##Meeting Location
• **6 Cuttings Wharf Rd, Napa CA**


##Includes
 • **Use of a high quality Specialized Town bike, helmet, unlimited bottled water, Wine Country picnic lunch, and professional local guides.**


##Wineries we may visit
 • **Etude, Bouchaine, Ceja, Mckenzie Mueller, Calmere, Sainstbury among others**
data.cancellation_notes: Getaway Adventures charges the full balance at the time of booking with a $25 per person non-refundable deposit, included in the price. Any cancellations made more than 3 days prior to the tour will be refunded the balance of their tour, less the $25 per person deposit. Any cancellations made within 3 days of the tour will be charged the full tour price, but a voucher for the full price will be issued and may be used towards any future tour.
